what: Telefônica Brasil, which trades as Vivo, is Brazil's largest telecom operator. It sells mobile service, fibre broadband and television, and has been expanding into digital services and payments.
customers: Brazilian households and businesses buying mobile, broadband and television services.
money: cloud, security and financial services for businesses
moat: The largest mobile subscriber base in Brazil and the widest fibre footprint, built over decades in a market with only three large operators.
risks: Brazilian consumer spending and inflation affect prepaid customers directly
Fibre overbuilding by smaller regional operators has increased competition
Regulatory decisions on spectrum and pricing affect economics
opportunities: Prepaid customers steadily converting to higher-value postpaid plans
Analysts see about 15% upside from current levels
watch: Postpaid subscriber growth and revenue per user.
